nodes.label: scripts/lib/dev-server.mjs: shared vite boot/teardown machinery (freePort, waitForHttp, killTree) extracted from e2e-devtools.mjs; e2e-devtools.mjs and eval-catalog-gate.mjs re-import it
nodes.accept: `node scripts/e2e-devtools.mjs selftest`, `node scripts/eval-catalog-gate.mjs selftest` and `node scripts/lib/dev-server.mjs selftest` all exit 0; `grep -c 'function killTree' scripts/*.mjs scripts/lib/*.mjs` counts exactly 1

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin.mjs: the entry (argv modes run | record | selftest | list, --only, exit 0/1/2)
nodes.accept: `node scripts/e2e-admin.mjs bogus` exits 2; `node scripts/e2e-admin.mjs list` prints every registered flow name and exits 0; `npm run e2e:admin` exits 0 on a clean tree

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/scenario.ts: the AdminScenario v1 fixture format (type, parseScenario with field-naming errors, scrubScenario)
nodes.accept: selftest: parseScenario rejects a fixture missing `turns[0].respond` naming that field; scrubScenario throws on a value matching a provider-key shape and passes a clean fixture; `npm run check:tools` type-checks the module

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/intercept.ts: Playwright route layer (block non-origin, answer /status, /integrations, /chat, / from the scenario's turn queue in order with match, delay, error, abort) plus the Node-side wire log
nodes.accept: selftest drives installIntercept against a fake route object: a produce POST consumes turn 0, a mismatched `match` records outcome 'unmatched', an `abort` turn calls route.abort, a non-origin URL is aborted, and the wire log carries {seq, endpoint, request, outcome, turnIndex}

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/admin-page.ts: the page object (ADMIN_SELECTORS data-part list, openAdmin with storage seeding via addInitScript and the runner-armed wait, composer drivers, pane/tab/persona/settings actions, transcript/storage/turn-count readers)
nodes.accept: the Test Chat greeting flow passes through openAdmin + sendTestChat + waitForTurn + readTestTranscript against a real vite; `npm run check:tools` type-checks the module

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/runner.ts: flow registry execution (one vite per run, fresh browser context per flow, per-flow timeout, results table, negative-control group that requires a wrong-behavior fixture to red its flow)
nodes.accept: `node scripts/e2e-admin.mjs --only chat-greeting-note` exits 0; with the negative fixture pair registered, the run exits 1 if the wrong-behavior fixture does NOT fail its flow (selftest proves this with a stubbed always-pass flow)

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/flows/test-chat.ts: five Test Chat flows (greeting note, surface render, client click turn, ask and answer, flowEnd chrome)
nodes.accept: `node scripts/e2e-admin.mjs --only chat-*` runs 5 flows green; each asserts at least one of DOM, testChatTranscript(), wire log

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/flows/builder.ts: Builder flows (arm via New agent, patch applies to the draft store, plan renders, team declared, section routing keeps the Test composer on session test, persona switch clears authoringStore)
nodes.accept: `node scripts/e2e-admin.mjs --only builder-*` runs at least 5 flows green; the patch flow asserts the draft's persisted key `agent-admin-app.<draftId>` carries the patched value and the wire log shows builderMission true on the Builder POST

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/flows/settings.ts: Settings flows (edit persists, kind toggle, entry add and remove, persona picker, Reset Agent)
nodes.accept: `node scripts/e2e-admin.mjs --only settings-*` runs 5 flows green; the edit flow reloads the page and asserts the value survived in localStorage and in the DOM

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/flows/personas-teams.ts: persona switch starts a fresh session; teams create and validate
nodes.accept: the persona-switch flow asserts liveTurnCount() reset to 0 and the next POST carries no prior history; the team flow asserts a record under the `agent-ui-agent-teams` namespace with the declared members

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/flows/failure-paths.ts: an error turn (503 {error} and a terminal a2uiMeta.error line) and an aborted connection, each leaving the composer re-enabled
nodes.accept: both flows green: after the failure the composer send control is enabled and a following scripted turn completes

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/fixtures/*.json and fixtures/negative/*.json: committed scenario fixtures (raw NDJSON wire lines incl. meta-lines) plus the two wrong-behavior fixtures (patch to the wrong key, missing flowEnd)
nodes.accept: every fixture parses under parseScenario in selftest; the two negative fixtures each red their named flow in the run's negative-control group

nodes.label: scripts/e2e-admin/record.ts: record mode (routes pass through via route.fetch, tees request and NDJSON response into a scenario, scrubs, refuses to write unscrubbed; exits 2 when /status is not available)
nodes.accept: selftest: the tee builds a scenario whose turns equal the observed request/response pairs and the scrub refusal path is exercised with a planted key-shaped value; manual: `npm run e2e:admin:record -- --flow chat-greeting-note --out /tmp/x.json` writes a parseable fixture with a key in .env

nodes.label: package.json and tsconfig.tools.json wiring (e2e:admin, e2e:admin:record, selftests appended to check:scripts, scripts/e2e-admin added to the tools type gate)
nodes.accept: `npm run check` exits 0 and its check:scripts leg runs both `scripts/lib/dev-server.mjs selftest` and `scripts/e2e-admin.mjs selftest`

nodes.label: docs scrub: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md Commands; component-testing SKILL + test-craft; a2ui-build, a2ui-prompt-authoring, a2ui AGENTS; devtools-harness.spec cross-ref; a2ui-live spec + admin live-model LLD (page.route seam); agent-model glossary (flow, fixture); goals.md gates line; ADR-0200 note
nodes.accept: `doc_lint` and `npm run check` exit 0; `grep -l 'e2e:admin' CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md .claude/skills/component-testing/SKILL.md .claude/docs/references/agent-model.md` lists all four

nodes.label: .github/workflows/e2e-admin.yml: a separate PR job installing Chromium and running npm run e2e:admin (gated on a Kim ruling; ci.yml stays browserless)
nodes.accept: if ruled in: the workflow runs green on the PR; if ruled out: no workflow file and the ticket's CI claim is reworded to local-and-agent runs

edges.why: the entry imports the shared boot machinery
the responder consumes the parsed scenario's turn queue
record writes the same scenario shape parseScenario reads
the runner installs the intercept per browser context
the runner hands flows the page object
flows implement the runner's AdminFlow contract
fixtures are written against the pinned format
the entry dispatches into the runner
package.json names the entry and its selftest
docs cite the final script names
